title: American Greed
description:
S5 E38 — 38 - Financial Guru Gone Bad
An "asset protection" guru steals millions from the famous, elderly and sick; he makes money disappear in a Ponzi scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E12 — The Lady Killer
A Florida man wins millions in the lottery then disappears.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Troubled Waters
A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Blood Lines
An inmate takes drastic action and leaves his cell in a bloody mess; dangerous contraband is found on another inmate at Florida's Santa Rosa Correctional Institution.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Close Quarters
The vast majority of inmates live in two-man cells but even with careful screening, conflicts can still arise between cellmates; one inmate covers up his own beating, and plucked from death row, another inmate tries to make a difference.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Pain
One reality of prison is that there's never a shortage of pain, and at the Limon Correctional Facility in Colorado, there's enough left over for the visitors as well; drama unfolds as a father and son try to reconcile a violent past.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — No More Franks And Beans
A first time inmate says he must turn to violence to avoid becoming a victim, an accused rapist gets into more trouble in jail and what he does next has some questioning his motives.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wake Up Call
Confinement takes a dark turn for a light-hearted teenager, but provides a new beginning for an old bank robber inside the Orange County Jail; a mother who has put drugs before her son gets another chance.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Highs and Lows
The Emergency Response Team have their hands full of a sadistic murderer who transforms the jail, a roller derby queen who takes a hard fall and one inmate who realizes that even a good day in jail can have a dark side.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Brotherhood
Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — 352,955 Days to Life
One inmate contends that a law could put him away forever; an inmate sentenced to life without parole prays that a new law will set him free.
